checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Coffee cup on windowsill with visible rain outside
must.why: Cup on a saucer on a wooden sill, rain streaks and droplets on the window.

must.item: Steam visibly curls upward from the cup
must.why: In the vertical clip the steam is a faint grey haze, hardly visible and not clearly curling from the cup. The widescreen clip has clearer steam.
The look is a warm, moody painterly style, but it reads closer to a photoreal or CG render than a storybook illustration.

must.item: About 6 seconds, no text or audio
must.why: No text is visible in any frame. Duration is stated as 6 seconds. Audio cannot be heard, but it was requested silent.

faults.what: A human hand reaches toward the cup at the start of the vertical clip and then vanishes. The user asked for no people.
Steam in the vertical version is nearly invisible, a faint smudge against the background.
The style is semi-photoreal rather than clearly illustrated.
A stray yellow object at the left edge in early frames, and a hand-and-cup shift as the cup repositions.

summary: The vertical rainy-window coffee cup is atmospheric and the format is right, but a hand intrudes at the start despite the no-people brief, the steam is barely visible, and the look is more photoreal than illustrated.
